    <footnotes>
        <footnote id="F1">Pursuant to the Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation of MSGS Spinco, Inc. (to be renamed MSG Rangers Corp. and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) filed by MSGR on October 20, 2026, the 100 outstanding shares of common stock of MSGR were automatically converted into an aggregate of 9,794,568 fully-paid and nonassessable shares of Class A Common Stock of MSGR and 2,264,754 fully-paid and nonassessable shares of Class B Common Stock of MSGR (the &quot;Recapitalization&quot;), in a transaction exempt pursuant to Rule 16b-7 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the &quot;Exchange Act&quot;). The Recapitalization did not result in a change in the pecuniary interest of Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (to be renamed MSG Knickerbockers Corp. and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;) in MSGR.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F2">On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of MSGR Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A Common Stock and MSGK Class B Common Stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Section 16 pursuant to Rule 16a-9 under the Exchange Act. As a result of the Distribution, MSGK no longer beneficially owns any shares of MSGR and consequently is no longer subject to the requirements of Section 16 of the Exchange Act with respect to MSGR.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F3">Class B Common Stock of MSGR is convertible at the option of the holder on a one-for-one basis into Class A Common Stock of MSGR.</footnote>
    </footnotes>
